lines.lyric_hangul: Oh My God 두 볼이 화끈
lines.lyric_translation: Oh my god
My cheeks are too hot / My heart keeps pounding
My deeply hidden heart
Tickles so I frown without knowing
Oh my god
All day, I feel strange
This is what having butterflies feels like, right?

lines.lyric_hangul: 바로 너지 어쩜 좋아 반했나 봐
lines.lyric_translation: I got a feeling, it was you / What do I do? I think I fell for you
You pop like carbonated water, making my heart pound
You drive me crazy, so fresh
What if you find out how I feel? Even my voice
Became half a pitch higher

lines.lyric: Eomeo nollaweora Wow wow wo wow wow
lines.lyric_hangul: 어머 놀라워라 Wow Wow Wo Wow Wow
lines.lyric_translation: Oh my, so amazing wow wow wo wow wow
Whenever I see you, my heart keeps going
My head is going crazy already
I’m with you, just us two

lines.lyric: Eojjeona Oh my god neon naman bwa
lines.lyric_translation: What to do? Oh my god, only look at me

lines.lyric_hangul: 넌 나만 봐 너만 몰라 Oh My God
lines.lyric_translation: Only you don’t know, oh my god

lines.lyric_hangul: 넌 나만 봐 너만 몰라 Oh My God
lines.lyric_translation: Only you don’t know, oh my god
I have a question, why are you so hot?
Even your personality is cool, you freeze me up
You have that twist, your eye smile confuses me
You look like you came straight from a romance anime
All day, I’m thinking about you, curious about you

lines.lyric_hangul: 참을 수가 없지 보고 싶지 알고 싶지
lines.lyric_translation: I can’t hold it in / I miss you, I wanna know you
What to do? I think it’s love
All my boring feelings have been erased

lines.lyric: Oh mabeop gatatjo han beone ssak
lines.lyric_hangul: Oh 마법 같았죠 한 번에 싹
lines.lyric_translation: Like magic, all at once

lines.lyric: Eodie gado tiga na mareul an haedo
lines.lyric_hangul: 어디에 가도 티가 나 말을 안 해도
lines.lyric_translation: Wherever I go, it’s obvious, even if I don’t say it
